title: Fix codex review findings for tasks 6, 7, 8
description:
Address findings from codex adversarial review of v1/6, v1/7, v1/8.

## DD engine (v1/8) — [high]
Eviction dropped facts, making re-query impossible without re-ingest. Population was eager (ingest spawned worker immediately), not lazy.

Fix: Added `Loaded` state. `ingest()` stores facts without spawning worker (Cold→Loaded). `query_cycles()` auto-warms on first call (Loaded→Warm). `evict_if_idle()` preserves facts (Warm→Loaded). `update()` works in both Loaded and Warm states.

## Migration runner (v1/6) — [high]
Retroactive registration blindly stamped all migrations as applied without verifying the schema they should have produced. A partially-migrated DB would be permanently marked complete.

Fix: `register_retroactive()` now checks each migration's expected schema (tables via sqlite_master, columns via PRAGMA table_info). Present → register. Missing → actually run the migration with savepoint rollback.

## Diagnostics freshness (v1/7) — [medium]
Diagnostic variants had no freshness envelope, making stale-index no-matches indistinguishable from true absence.

Fix: Added `freshness: Option<FreshnessLevel>` to all relevant Diagnostic variants. `sutra_find` populates from workspace FreshnessCounts. `sutra_refs`/`sutra_calls` pass None (workspace root not yet threaded through).

## Outline compact default — [medium]
Compact mode defaulted to true, silently dropping fields the MCP contract advertised.

Fix: Default changed to false. Compact is now opt-in."
